recognize_zh: A–B 面板周邊血中可見偏心核、核周淡染區與深藍細胞質的漿細胞及漿細胞樣淋巴球；流式圖 H 顯示 cytoplasmic kappa/lambda 約 56%/44% 的多株型（polytypic）分布，雖有 CD56+、CD19− 等表面異常，仍支持反應性而非腫瘤性漿細胞。
features: Panels A-B: circulating mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Smaller plasmacytoid lymphocytes with moderate basophilic cytoplasm accompany the plasma cells
Background red cells without rouleaux; no plasmablastic cells with prominent nucleoli
Panels C-D: CD138+/CD38 bright plasma cell gate with dim CD45 and CD19 negativity
Panels E-G: CD81+, CD27−, CD56+, CD117− plasma cells (partly aberrant-appearing phenotype)
Panel H: cytoplasmic kappa ~56% and lambda ~44%, indicating a polytypic population
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing, along with plasmacytoid lymphocytes; no plasmablasts or rouleaux are seen. Flow cytometry identifies a small CD138+ CD38 bright plasma cell population that is CD45 dim, CD19 negative, CD27 negative, CD81 positive, CD56 positive and CD117 negative. Cytoplasmic light chain analysis shows both kappa- and lambda-expressing plasma cells in a near-normal ratio. Despite CD19 loss and CD56 expression, the polytypic light chain pattern and transient course favor reactive plasmacytosis in the setting of chronic inflammatory disease.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell leukemia / circulating myeloma cells
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted (monotypic kappa or lambda) on flow, whereas this population is polytypic.
LPL shows a monotypic CD19+ B-cell component with plasmacytoid differentiation, typically with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis from viral infection (e.g., EBV, dengue)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation rests on clinical context, serology and resolution on follow-up.
